name: What are the common signs of a gas line problem with a dryer?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a gas line problem with a dryer?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might notice a distinct sulfur or rotten egg smell near your dryer, which is a strong indicator of a gas leak. Other signs include the dryer not heating properly or taking an unusually long time to dry clothes. You may also hear a hissing sound near the gas line. If you observe any of these symptoms, it's crucial to turn off the gas supply to your dryer and contact a professional immediately to prevent potential hazards. Do not attempt to locate the leak yourself using an open flame.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include a rotten egg smell, the dryer not heating, or a hissing sound near the gas line. Turn off the gas and call a professional if you notice these.
